messages.author: 8b5528dd7856a600
messages.subject: Rstan unpredictable recompilation
parts:
I’ve seen a few threads recently (one, two, three, four, Github #265) about inconsistencies in when rstan recompiles a model and when it doesn’t. Most seem to involve reusing a model within the same R session , but I’ve been having trouble even when repeating fully scripted runs in separate sessions.

I think I’ve found a culprit for this, but it’s a weird one. Rstan seems to... always recompile any model that doesn’t end with a newline?

Demo below.

—Chris

-----------

#/!bin/bash

printf '
set.seed(1234)
library(rstan)
rstan_options(auto_write=TRUE)
stanfile = commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[[1]]
stan(file=stanfile, verbose=TRUE) 
# verbose just to make compilation obvious
' > null.R

printf '%b' "data{}parameters{}model{}\n" > null1.stan
printf '%b' "data{}parameters{}model{}" > null2.stan

# First run: both compile as expected
Rscript null.R "null1.stan" > null1.log
Rscript null.R "null2.stan" > null2.log

# Confirm that saved models do exist
ls null*.rda

# Second and subsequent runs: 
# null1 run from saved model as expected,
# null2 recompiles every time
# Both models do nothing, as expected.
Rscript null.R "null1.stan" > null1_2.log
Rscript null.R "null2.stan" > null2_2.log
# ...etc...

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Rstan unpredictable recompilation
parts:
On Wednesday, July 20, 2016 at 4:26:22 PM UTC-4, Chris Black wrote:
I think I’ve found a culprit for this, but it’s a weird one. Rstan seems to... always recompile any model that doesn’t end with a newline?

Wow. One of the checks is that the md5sum of null2.stan matches that of the Stan code inside null2.rda when written to a tempfile, which adds a terminating newline. I'll see what I can do about this, but for now, everyone end your Stan programs with a newline.

Thanks,
Ben
